title: Report ID should not be affected by push/pop
body:
The [note under parsing the report descriptor](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#issue-container-generatedID-3) says "The global Report ID value is not affected when manipulating the item state stack." However, the way this is implemented contradicts this, as [under the "if *item* is a Global item" section](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#ref-for-dfn-report-id-tag-1) step 9 states:

> If item has the Report ID tag, then set globalState["reportId"] to value.

and since push and pop act on the `globalState`, that would include the Report ID.

The HID spec seems to also indicate that Report ID should not be affected by push/pop, per the description of Report ID in section 6.2.2.7:

> All items succeeding the first Report ID tag but preceding a second Report ID tag are included in a report prefixed by a 1-byte ID. All items succeeding the second but preceding a third Report ID tag are included in a second report prefixed by a second ID, and so on.

which doesn't mention any exception for push/pop tags. (this also matches [what Chromium does](https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:services/device/hid/hid_item_state_table.h;l=74-75;drc=568680270312cbbd2d9afccae94461ea7af8e05d))

---

Note that this contradicts what the Linux HID parser does ([`report_id` is kept in `struct hid_global`](https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/master/include/linux/hid.h#L471), and [push copies the whole `hid_global`](https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/master/drivers/hid/hid-core.c#L421-L422)). So I'm guessing this situation is pretty rare to begin with. But I think this is correct reading the original HID spec, and either way we should make this spec not contradict itself.

---

To address this, I think the cleanest thing to do is to make the changes:

- In the Global item steps, replace "If |item| has the Report ID tag, then set globalState["reportId"] to value" with: "If item has the Report ID tag, then set reportId to value."
- In the Input/Output/Feature steps, remove "Let reportId be globalState['reportId']". The later steps that refer to reportId will then use the outer variable.
